EVAL.scope: 19 application E2E IDs, READ negatives and bounded deterministic provider; no real-model or universal clinical accreditation

COST.scope: durable admission, shared budget, caps/reserved tokens, no refund, timeout/retry, restart and unknown usage

SCALE.scope: N-1/N/N+1, two independent planners/sender, durable saturated work, budget/capacity/witness composition; other timed variants stopped

SAFETY.scope: safety, handoff/takeover, correction, consent/duplicates; pending-safety-after-W1 uses prior final-source proof

DURABILITY.scope: crash/restart, lease expiry, stale worker, provider timeout, sender uncertainty, receipt SQL rollback; not power-loss or exactly-once remote guarantees
